ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) Chrome credential harvest via malicious logon GPO script
ucs.description: Detects Qilin's signature 2024 TTP: a domain-pushed logon GPO script (executed via gpscript.exe) spawning PowerShell/wscript that copies Chrome/Edge 'Login Data' SQLite databases to a staging share. Sophos and GuidePoint documented this exact chain on multiple Qilin intrusions where the affiliates dropped IPScanner.ps1 / LogonPasswords.ps1 under SYSVOL and harvested every domain user's saved browser credentials at next interactive logon.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name=gpscript.exe AND Processes.process_name IN (powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, cmd.exe, wscript.exe, cscript.exe) AND (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\User Data\\*" OR Processes.process="*LogonPasswords*" OR Processes.process="*IPScanner*" OR Processes.process="*SYSVOL*" OR Processes.process="*vaultcli*" OR Processes.process="*sqlite*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%F %T"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%F %T") | sort 0 - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LogonScript = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe"
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChildPid = ProcessId, ChildImage = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let CredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FolderPath has_any (@"\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Edge\User Data\", @"\Brave-Browser\User Data\", @"\Vivaldi\User Data\")
             and FileName in~ ("Login Data","Web Data","Cookies","Local State"))
         or (FolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\" and FileName endswith ".ps1")
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, FileName, FolderPath,
              ActorPid = InitiatingProcessId, ActorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ActorFile = InitiatingProcessFileName;
LogonScript
| join kind=inner CredAccess on DeviceId
| where FileTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project ScriptTime = Timestamp, FileTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ChildImage, ChildCmd, FileName, FolderPath, ActorFile, ActorCmd
| order by ScriptTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LogonScript = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe"
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe"
       or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
       or NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
       or NewProcessName endswith "\\wscript.exe"
       or NewProcessName endswith "\\cscript.exe"
    | project ScriptTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              TargetUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
let CredAccess = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where (TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Chrome\User Data\", @"\Edge\User Data\", @"\Brave-Browser\User Data\")
             and TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","Web Data","Cookies","Local State"))
         or (TargetFilePath has @"\SYSVOL\" and TargetFileName endswith ".ps1")
    | project FileTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName,
              TargetFilePath, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine;
LogonScript
| join kind=inner (CredAccess) on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname
| where FileTime between (ScriptTime .. ScriptTime + 5m)
| project ScriptTime, FileTime, Computer, TargetUserName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, TargetFileName,
          TargetFilePath, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by ScriptTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin Ransomware Logon-GPO Credential Harvester
id: 8f4d2b3c-1a76-4c4d-9e21-2f1c2dbfa9a1
status: experimental
description: Detects gpscript.exe spawning a script interpreter whose command line touches Chrome/Edge Login Data, SYSVOL .ps1 payloads, or the LogonPasswords/IPScanner artefacts publicly attributed to Qilin (Agenda) ransomware affiliates.
references:
    - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/09
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    parent:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
    child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\wscript.exe'
            - '\cscript.exe'
    intent:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Login Data'
            - '\User Data\'
            - 'LogonPasswords'
            - 'IPScanner'
            - '\SYSVOL\'
            - 'vaultcli'
    condition: parent and child and intent
falsepositives:
    - Custom corporate logon scripts that legitimately enumerate browser-profile paths (rare)
level: high
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1037.001
    - attack.t1555.003
    - attack.t1059.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"User Data"* OR *LogonPasswords* OR *IPScanner* OR *SYSVOL* OR *sysvol* OR *vaultcli*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Login Data|\\\\User Data\\\\|LogonPasswords|IPScanner|\\\\SYSVOL\\\\|vaultcli)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: gpscript.exe is the Group Policy logon-script host — its child should be the customer's own logon batch, never PowerShell that reads a Chrome SQLite. Pairing gpscript.exe → interpreter → 'Login Data' / SYSVOL .ps1 within 5 minutes mirrors the exact chain Sophos documented on Qilin/Agenda intrusions where the affiliates pushed IPScanner.ps1 and LogonPasswords.ps1 via a malicious GPO. ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) ransomware pre-encryption sabotage burst on a single host
ucs.description: Detects the characteristic Qilin pre-encryption command burst — vssadmin/wmic shadow copy deletion, wbadmin catalog wipe, bcdedit recovery disable, and Veeam/MSSQL/EDR service stops — issued from one host inside a 5-minute window. Group-IB and Trend Micro have published Qilin's Rust binary command list; affiliates run this exact sequence seconds before launching the encryptor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.process_name) as binaries from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*resize shadowstorage*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND (Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*delete backup*" OR Processes.process="*delete systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR ((Processes.process_name=net.exe OR Processes.process_name=net1.exe OR Processes.process_name=sc.exe) AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND (Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQLSERVER*" OR Processes.process="*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*Acronis*" OR Processes.process="*MSExchange*" OR Processes.process="*CrowdStrike*" OR Processes.process="*SentinelOne*" OR Processes.process="*Sense*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*"))) by host Processes.user _time span=5m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval shadow=if(match(commands,"(?i)delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|resize shadowstorage"),1,0), backup=if(match(commands,"(?i)delete catalog|delete backup|delete systemstatebackup"),1,0), boot=if(match(commands,"(?i)recoveryenabled no|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"),1,0), services=if(match(commands,"(?i)stop.*(Veeam|BackupExec|MSSQLSERVER|SQLAgent|Acronis|MSExchange|CrowdStrike|SentinelOne|Sense|WinDefend)"),1,0) | eval distinct_actions = shadow + backup + boot + services | where distinct_actions >= 3 | eval firstTime=strftime(firstTime,"%F %T"), lastTime=strftime(lastTime,"%F %T") | sort 0 - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Action = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"), "ShadowDelete",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete", "ShadowDelete",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"), "BackupDelete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "BootRecoveryDisable",
    FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop"
        and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","BackupExec","MSSQLSERVER","SQLAgent","Acronis","MSExchange","CrowdStrike","SentinelOne","Sense","WinDefend"), "ServiceKill",
    "")
| where Action != ""
| summarize Actions = make_set(Action),
            DistinctActions = dcount(Action),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where DistinctActions >= 3   // 3+ distinct sabotage categories in 5min = Qilin pre-encrypt burst
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMin = 5m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Action = case(
    NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"), "ShadowDelete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy delete", "ShadowDelete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete catalog","delete systemstatebackup","delete backup"), "BackupDelete",
    NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"), "BootRecoveryDisable",
    (NewProcessName endswith "\\net.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\net1.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\sc.exe")
        and CommandLine has "stop"
        and CommandLine has_any ("Veeam","BackupExec","MSSQLSERVER","SQLAgent","Acronis","MSExchange","CrowdStrike","SentinelOne","Sense","WinDefend"), "ServiceKill",
    "")
| where Action != ""
| summarize Actions = make_set(Action),
            DistinctActions = dcount(Action),
            Commands = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            Binaries = make_set(NewProcessName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where DistinctActions >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"resize shadowstorage"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete backup"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:*"shadowcopy delete"*) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\NET1.EXE OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.EXE) @CommandLine:(*stop* AND (*Veeam* OR *BackupExec* OR *MSSQLSERVER* OR *SQLAgent* OR *Acronis* OR *CrowdStrike* OR *SentinelOne* OR *WinDefend*))))
ucs.rationale: Any one of these commands is mildly noisy on backup hosts; three distinct categories from the same interactive user inside 5 minutes is the published Qilin/Agenda Rust-encryptor command burst (Group-IB, Trend Micro, Sophos IR write-ups).
